reason: I already get drafts from ChatGPT with a saved brief per client, and I rewrite most of them anyway. Nothing here shows me that pasting 5 to 10 posts gives a voice clients approve without edits, so I would not pay on faith.
objection: Voice-learning from a handful of posts sounds like what I already do with a saved prompt. The approval link and CSV export are nice, but they are not what costs me time. My time goes on rewriting drafts that miss the client's voice.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial on two of my real clients where the batch comes out and the clients approve most posts with no edits from me. At that point 15 a month would be an easy yes.
